decision: All69 reference contracts are sufficiently described and checked across their four domains, source/semantic identity, actual target adapters and transitive token/CSS bindings. Native provenance remains separately auditable.
limits: Bounded representative source recipes, not universal framework/device/AT or pixel certification.
Canonical HTML/CSS is a domain projection, actual React/primitive adapters own runtime behavior.
Pinned upstream Calendar focus omission is repaired by an explicit supported reference ref adapter; raw source regression remains.
Historical native-token/layer-v1 receipts remain byte-preserved; they are not treated as current leading rules.
